description:
AGENTS.md pre-commit gate explicitly lists `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` as required. Currently fails with ~46 errors across 9 crates (jmap-server, jmap-mail-server, jmap-chat-server, jmap-contacts-server, jmap-calendars-server, jmap-calendars-types, jmap-tasks-server, jmap-filenode-server, jmap-sharing-server).

Categories of errors:
- 21x unnecessary_fallible_conversions: Id::try_from(literal).unwrap() should be Id::from(literal) — Id implements From<&str> infallibly
- 21x clone_on_ref_ptr / slice clone: foo.clone() where slice::from_ref(&foo) is cleaner
- 8x or_insert_with(Foo::default) should be or_default()
- 7x useless vec![] (could be array literal)
- 5x map_or simplification
- 4x assert_eq!(x, true) — should be assert!(x)
- 1x for-loop with index that could be enumerate/iter
- 1x doc list indent
- 1x always-true expression

To reproduce: `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`

This blocks any meaningful 'publish readiness' status and was likely missed by the recent version bump commit.
title: P1: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings fails
